statusValues.pass: screenshot succeeded AND visualCheckPassed=true from vision model
statusValues.partial: screenshot succeeded but no vision model check performed
statusValues.skipped: screenshot not available (not attempted or failed)
statusValues.fail: screenshot succeeded AND visualCheckPassed=false from vision model

pass2Integration.defaultBehavior: no screenshotStatus in config → treated as not-provided, critic_vision_blind=true, visualGateStatus=skipped

emptyCanvasBlock.reason: A 0×0 canvas produces an unusable empty image; it's misleading to report success
emptyCanvasBlock.behavior: posts error:'empty_canvas: 0x0 dimensions, screenshot not captured', returns early

timeoutBlock.reason: html2canvas can hang on complex pages; hanging indefinitely blocks the critic loop
timeoutBlock.behavior: Promise.race rejects after SCREENSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS with screenshot_timeout error

codeOnlyPassBlocked.description: When screenshot is unavailable (codeOnlyVisualPassBlocked=true), the critic cannot claim a visual acceptance
codeOnlyPassBlocked.rationale: Code-only analysis cannot substitute for visual evidence; marking visual pass without evidence is misleading
